content:
Ravi: FYI I opened a docs PR for the private installer quickstart + tiny SDK example for on-prem users: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/489
Ana: Nice. Quick notes after a skim: the port matrix link in the network section points to an old anchor and the KMS PKCS#11 example doesn't mention which env var names match which SDK release.
Tyler: I changed the anchor in the site refactor to `vpc-network-ports`, so the link should be updated in the PR.
Maria: On the PKCS#11 vars 1: older SDKs expect `PKCS11_MODULE_PATH` and newer ones use `PKCS11_MODULE`. We should show both and add a compatibility callout.
Ravi: Good call. I'll add a short compatibility note and a tiny code sample showing a flexible lookup (both envs).
Ana: Also include a checksum verification step for air-gapped RPM tarballs. We had a bad mirror once so please add the gpg example and sha256 check.
Ravi: Draft snippets I'm planning to add:

```bash
# verify sha256
sha256sum -c redwood-offline-1.2.3.tar.gz.sha256
# verify GPG signature
gpg --verify redwood-offline-1.2.3.tar.gz.asc redwood-offline-1.2.3.tar.gz
```

```js
// minimal private SDK bootstrap (on-prem)
const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood.Client({
  baseURL: process.env.REDWOOD_BASE_URL || 'https://private.example.internal',
  apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY,
  kms: {
    provider: 'pkcs11',
    modulePath: process.env.PKCS11_MODULE || process.env.PKCS11_MODULE_PATH,
    tokenLabel: process.env.HSM_TOKEN || 'redwood-token',
  }
});
```

Tyler: Add a note about LD_LIBRARY_PATH for PKCS#11 modules on Ubuntu vs CentOS and a systemd drop-in. I can paste the one-liner drop-in to export LD_LIBRARY_PATH if you want.
Maria: Also add a short bullet that the installer runs as the `redwood` user, so module files need at least read permission for that user or group.
Ana: I'll update the broken anchor and wire the link to the migration guide for cloud->HSM (so the quickstart stays short). We have that migration doc at `/private/migrate-from-cloud-kms.md` but it isn't linked from the quickstart currently.
Ravi: Sounds good. Can docs-bot run linkcheck on the branch after we push these edits? Want to catch any other broken anchors before merge.
docs-bot: scheduled linkcheck for branch `ravi/private-quickstart` 1: results will be posted back here when ready. :robot_face:
Ana: Assigning myself for the anchor + GPG/checksum prose.
Tyler: I'll add the LD_LIBRARY_PATH systemd drop-in and test PKCS#11 on Ubuntu 22.04.
Maria: I'll confirm SDK versions for the env var names and add the permissions bullet.
Ravi: Great 1: target to merge by EOD tomorrow if linkcheck is clean. Thanks all. :shipit:
